chapter: The Raeburn band: people and touring
title: Singer David Allyn
summary: Handy loved David Allyn, who hopes to come back east and sing with him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: David was on the band when you came back?
How did you get on with David?
Beautifully, beautifully; I loved him; what a marvelous person.
He was more musician than a singer. Of course he is a player, isn't he? He played something.
It seems to me he wrote things even. Maybe I imagined that, or confused it.
David, at any rate, is a very musical singer.
He was always happy, I'm certain, with the material that you did for him, excited by it.
I would hope that he was. I felt that he was. He found me last week, I think, he said he was coming back east. He spoke about singing with me, just he and I.

Yes, I think he'd like to do something like that. He said Hollywood is no place for him, no way for him to make a living out there. I talked to somebody in the Veterans Administration about getting him, perhaps, a job out here, as a drug consultant, to at least get him to make the move. I haven't talked to anybody for a couple of weeks; I'm not sure what's happening. That may help.
